title: Crash in vulkan code on 4.5.1-stable on Linux
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible: v4.5.1.stable.mono.official [f62fdbde1]

### System information

Godot v4.5.1.stable - Ubuntu 24.04.3 LTS 24.04 on X11 - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Forward+) - integrated Intel(R) Iris(R) Xe Graphics (ADL GT2) - 12th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-1255U (12 threads) - 15.31 GiB memory

### Issue description

I am not sure what action caused godot to crash or if it is a godot issue at all but it only seems to trigger when I am using godot.

All I know is I was switching from godot editor to firefox to unpause a video when the system froze up and godot crashed.

Here is the systemd journal log from the crash no logfile was generated.
